offering_description.value: Operates thrift stores that sell donated secondhand clothing and household goods to individual shoppers, and sells unsold donated textiles in bulk to wholesale buyers. Donations are collected from the public and through nonprofit partners.

primary_products.value: secondhand clothing; household goods; books and media; furniture; small electronics

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual shoppers buying secondhand goods in stores; B2B: wholesale buyers purchasing unsold textiles in bulk

revenue_model.value: product sales: secondhand goods sold to shoppers in stores; product sales: bulk sales of unsold textiles to wholesale buyers

value_chain_position.value: retailer: takes in donated goods and sells them to individual shoppers; other: sorts unsold goods and sells them in bulk to wholesale buyers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: secondhand clothing, household goods, books, furniture and electronics sold through the same store format

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated thrift stores across the United States and Canada; other: bulk sales of unsold goods to wholesale buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer product safety, labor, environmental and local retail licensing rules apply to stores and sorting operations

notes: Store counts, Europe activity and exact product mix are approximate.
